_doc: Thúy Vi Tông signature items and sets (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Unpriced proposals: modifier sizes follow the wood and earth catalogues' grade 2-4 items. Effects are hand-written rules, unpriced. Gaps: there is no whisk base (the White Cloud Whisk uses phien, the nearest waved implement) and no alchemy/craft modifier key, so craft edges are written as effects.

items.name: White Cloud Whisk (Bạch Vân Phất Trần)

effects.name: Brush Away the Dust (Phất Trần)
effects.rule: Once every 20 s, the whisk brushes one debuff off you or an ally beside you and turns its remaining time into a ward of the same length.

items.lore: White horsehair on a handle of Không Sơn cypress, made in 300. Thôi Bất Kiến gave it to Phùng Yên Hà with the hills in 500 (C100), and Ngu Lam Sơn took it in 1000 (C173). It is a Wind treasure in a Wood sect, and no head has held the Wind to wake it fully. Legendary item bach_van_phat_tran.
items.build_use: The head's guard: evasion, cleansing and linh lực for a man who never learned a killing art.

items.name: Seal of the Emerald Haze (Thúy Vi Ấn)
items.lore: Green jade from Bích Ngọc Khoáng, the first stone cut after the mine was opened in 505 (A037). Every writ of the sect bears it, and its stamp smells faintly of wet leaves.
items.build_use: The head's offence and his haze: Wood damage and stronger Wood buffs.

items.name: Robe of the Empty Green (Không Thúy Y)

effects.name: The Robe Is Never Dry (Y Bất Càn)
effects.rule: Burns on the wearer last half as long, and the first burn each fight is put out at once.

items.lore: Woven from hemp grown in the haze, after the line the sect is named for: no rain on the mountain road, yet the empty green wets our clothes. It has never been dry since 500.
items.build_use: Sustain and fire resistance for a long, slow fight.

items.name: Founder's Seed Gourd (Tổ Sư Chủng Hồ)

effects.name: A Seed for the Fallen (Vị Vong Lưu Chủng)
effects.rule: Once a fight, when an ally beside you would fall, a seed takes root under them: they stay at 1 health for 2 s and are healed for a fifth of their health when it flowers.

items.lore: A dried gourd holding seeds from every life tree the founder planted. Phùng Yên Hà carried it up the ridge in 500. Cù Thúy Bách would not let it go down the mountain in 1006, and she will not hand it over until the sect comes back up.
items.build_use: The grand elder's sustain and her leverage: the third piece of the Regalia.

items.name: Cliff Pine Bark (Nhai Tùng Bì)
items.lore: A plate of bark the founder's pine shed in the storm of 1010, hardened by Cù Thúy Bách for a century. It is grey and split, and heavier than iron.
items.build_use: The Cliff Hall's guard: defence and block for the pine that does not move.

items.name: The Green Furnace (Thanh Lô)

effects.name: Green Fire (Thanh Hỏa)
effects.rule: Burns from your Wood arts deal 25 % more to foes below half health. Out of a fight, pills brewed in the furnace come out one grade cleaner, as if your Đan Đạo were one level higher (craft rule; no modifier key exists for it).

items.lore: A clay furnace the height of a child, glazed green on the inside by four hundred years of spirit-wood fire. Âu Dương Thanh Lô fired it in 540, and Úy Thanh Diễm has kept it lit since 932.
items.build_use: The Furnace Master's piece: slow green fire in a fight, cleaner pills out of one.

items.name: Pulse-Reading Needle (Thiết Mạch Châm)
items.lore: A long needle of pine-soot steel that Cao Đan Hà gave her apprentice in 915, for reading pulses. It is the only thing of hers he still has.
items.build_use: Fast Wood hits that keep the green fire's stacks on a foe.

items.name: Well-Field Seal (Tỉnh Điền Ấn)

effects.name: Nine Squares (Cửu Ô)
effects.rule: Out of a fight, the seal unfolds into a nine-square spirit field wherever it is pressed into soil; it carries the soil of the sect's fields with it (craft rule).

items.lore: A square of yellow stone cut with the nine squares of the old well-field. The first elder presses it into the ground wherever he stops for the night.
items.build_use: The first elder's Earth guard and sustain.

items.name: Gourd of a Hundred Herbs (Bách Thảo Hồ)
items.lore: The seed gourd of Bách Thảo Viện, carried out of the burning academy in 932 by the child Khổng Đương Quy (V029). It still holds a hundred kinds of seed.
items.build_use: Healing and regeneration for the herb gardens' keeper.

items.name: Lamp of the Cold Ford Quay (Hàn Tân Đăng)

effects.name: Lamp on the Quay (Ngạn Thượng Đăng)
effects.rule: Foes within the lamp's light cannot become hidden, and hidden foes who enter it are revealed.

items.lore: Hướng Đông Lâm's lamp. The fishers hid it under the quay stones of Hàn Tân when he fell beside it in 672 (C136), and his descendant dug it out, unbroken, when the ford came home in 905 (C166). It is lit on every boat-lamp night (A044).
items.build_use: A border warden's piece: accuracy and sight against haze and concealment.

items.name: Brass Lock of the Salt Chest (Diêm Rương Tỏa)
items.lore: The lock of the chest of salt the pirates left at Ẩn Loan cove with a child in 781 (A026). She wears it on a cord. It is cast with a whale, and it has no keyhole.
items.build_use: The port elder's staying power.

items.name: Green Moss Mirror (Thanh Đài Kính)

effects.name: Light on the Moss (Phục Chiếu Thanh Đài)
effects.rule: A quarter of the healing you receive is stored, and released on you the next time you fall below half health.

effects.name: The Empty Mountain's Answer (Không Sơn Đáp)
effects.rule: Healing lost to your full health is stored as Green, and the Green fades by a tenth each second. When the foe is Rooted or carries 5 or more of your Wood stacks, the Green falls on it as Wood damage, once every 3 s.

items.lore: A bronze mirror whose back has grown a skin of living moss. The head gave it to his disciple at her Kết Đan in 1180 with the line it is named for.
items.build_use: A healer's mirror: shares her healing with the weakest.

items.name: Lone Cypress Banner (Cô Bách Kỳ)
items.lore: Its pole is cypress from the groves Không Sơn's students planted at Bách Diệp as a lesson in patience (A034); its cloth is grey, with no device on it.
items.build_use: The Cliff Hall's offence: physical weight and crushing Wood stacks.

items.name: Evening Punt-Pole (Vãn Chu Cao)
items.lore: A fisher's bamboo punt-pole that her father had tempered when she reached Trúc Cơ. The Thúy Vi rule against drawing blades in the haze says nothing about poles.
items.build_use: Reach and Wood stacks for a coast fighter.

items.name: Foundling's Cloth (Khí Nhi Bố)
items.lore: The strip of green inner-gate silk he was wrapped in at the Green Door of Lam Yên Thị in 1166, sewn into the lining of his robe. It is Furnace Hall silk, and it smells of pine soot.
items.build_use: A young disciple's robe: health and longer Wood buffs.

items.name: Salt-Marsh Rain Cape (Diêm Trạch Thoa Y)
items.lore: A straw rain cape woven from the first reeds of the salt marsh she sowed in 1195, salt-white at the hem.
items.build_use: Guard and linh lực for a pole fighter who stands in the reeds.

items.name: Polygala Needle (Viễn Chí Châm)
items.lore: A needle cut from polygala root and steeped in the Furnace Hall's venom; he made it in one night and it is a little crooked.
items.build_use: Needles and venom, fast.

items.name: Rock-Splitting Root Axe (Phá Thạch Căn Phủ)
items.lore: A jade-cutter's splitting axe with a pine-root haft that has gone on growing for four hundred years; the head is the cutter's wedge from her father's workshop on the ridge.
items.build_use: Physical weight and Wood stacks to split a guard.

items.name: Charcoal-Clamp Robe (Thán Diêu Bào)
items.lore: A soot-grey robe of Thiêu Thán Thôn's clamp cloth, the cloth the charcoal-burners lay over the kilns. It keeps the poison in his blood from spreading while he works.
items.build_use: Guard for the alchemist who stands beside his own green fire.

items.name: Lime-Kiln Jacket (Thạch Hôi Giáp)
items.lore: A field-worker's jacket stiffened with lime from the kilns of Thiêu Hôi Thôn; it smells of burnt stone, like its wearer.
items.build_use: The first elder's Earth body: a shield that cannot be trampled.

items.name: Spear of the Quay (Thủ Ngạn Mâu)
items.lore: Forged in 910 from the iron mooring ring of the quay where Hướng Đông Lâm fell in 672; his family name is cut along the shaft.
items.build_use: Roots that hold: Wood damage and status duration.

items.name: Winter Quay Coat (Đông Ngạn Giáp)
items.lore: A warden's coat of oiled fish-leather for winter fights on the river ice.
items.build_use: Linh lực and cold guard for long winter fights.

items.name: Cove Wind Fan (Loan Phong Phiến)
items.lore: A pirate's sail-fan of whalebone and sailcloth, found under the salt in the chest the pirates left with her in 781.
items.build_use: A deck fighter's fan: Water hits that drain linh lực.
items.made_by: unknown (the pirates who left the chest)

items.name: Salt-Crusted Deck Robe (Diêm Giáp Bào)
items.lore: The chest's oilcloth wrapping, cut into a robe by the women of Ẩn Loan Thôn when she left with Ngu Lam Sơn.
items.build_use: Long sea fights: regeneration and evasion.
items.made_by: the women of Ẩn Loan Thôn

items.name: Poria Gourd (Phục Linh Hồ)
items.lore: A gourd grown over a poria knot under an old pine at Phục Linh Thôn; what is poured in comes out a little more healing.
items.build_use: The healer's sustain and longer Wood buffs.

items.name: Weeping Willow Robe (Thùy Liễu Bào)
items.lore: Green silk dyed with willow bark, given to her by Ngu Lam Sơn the day he chose her.
items.build_use: Guard for the healer who must not fall first.

items.name: Ridge Jade Buckler (Lĩnh Ngọc Thuẫn)
items.lore: His father's jade-cutting block, bound in pine root and turned into a buckler; he leans on foes with it.
items.build_use: A shield to lean on: block and weight.

items.name: Metal-Wind Coat (Kim Phong Giáp)
items.lore: Worn on the ridge where the Metal wind hardens the body; the Cliff Hall's champions have slept in it on stone since 700.
items.build_use: The pine's bark: health, defence and a body shield.

sets.name: Emerald Haze Regalia (Thúy Vi Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Green Comes Back (Thúy Hồi): the first time each fight you fall below a third of your health, haze rises around you for 6 s. Allies inside heal 3 % of their health each second, foes inside gain 2 Wood stacks each second, and your Wood arts cost nothing while it lasts.

sets.story: Phùng Yên Hà held all three. The seal and the robe went down to Cổ Dịch Trấn with Ngu Lam Sơn in 1006. The gourd stayed on the ridge with Cù Thúy Bách, who says the founder's seeds belong beside the founder's tree. The Regalia has not been whole for 194 years, and Cù will trade the gourd only for the sect's return, or for the heir she chooses.

sets.name: Field and Garden (Điền Viên Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Field and Garden (Điền Viên): your heals over time also grant one Earth guard stack each second they tick, and while you hold 5 or more Earth guard stacks your health regeneration is doubled.

sets.story: The first elder's seal and jacket and his Dao partner's gourd. Each refuses to keep the other's piece. Each spring at the planting, whoever finished sowing first is handed the other's: in his years the set is whole for one season; in hers she wears the seal beside her gourd.

sets.name: Evening Ferry (Vãn Độ)

bonuses.effect: Reach and Root (Cập Viễn Trát Căn): a foe you root with a pole art stays rooted 1 s longer for each 3 Wood stacks it carries, and the root spends those stacks; each time the same foe is rooted this way again in a fight, the extra time is halved.

sets.story: The quay's pole and the marsh's reeds: the coast girl who chose to grow rice where her father wanted war.

sets.name: Far Ambition (Viễn Chí)

bonuses.effect: Everything at Once (Nhất Thời Tề Phát): when you use a pill, your next needle art casts at once and puts double Wood stacks, and your heals are 20 % stronger for 3 s.

sets.story: The cloth he was left in and the needle he made too fast: who he was and who he is in a hurry to be.

sets.name: Pine on the Cliff (Nhai Tùng)

bonuses.effect: The Pine That Does Not Move (Bất Động Tùng): while in Pine Against the Wind, each hit you block puts a Wood stack on the attacker, and your next root-splitting art deals 10 % more for each Wood stack on its target, and spends those stacks.

sets.story: Bark from the founder's pine and an axe from her father's workshop: the ridge's two crafts, wood and jade. Cù wears them beside the founder's Seed Gourd, which belongs to the Regalia and not to her.

sets.name: Green Fire (Thanh Hỏa Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: The Fire Lingers (Hỏa Bất Tận): when a foe's Wood stacks from you run out, they rekindle once as Burn stacks of half their number.

sets.story: The Furnace Hall's master's three: the green furnace he keeps, the needle he reads pulses with, and the clamp-cloth of his home village. Úy says the set will be whole only when the Purple Smoke Furnace sits beside it.

sets.name: Cold Ford Watch (Hàn Tân Canh)

bonuses.effect: No Hiding on the Quay (Ngạn Vô Ẩn): a foe you root loses its concealment and evasion while rooted, and each second it stays rooted your next Wood art against it deals 8 % more; that art spends the bonus, and it is lost when the root ends.

sets.story: The lamp found unbroken in 905, a spear from the quay's own iron and the warden's winter coat. The Cold Ford Hall's warden has worn the three since 940 and means his daughter to wear them after him.

sets.name: The Salt Chest (Diêm Rương Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: What the Chest Kept (Rương Trung Vật): once a fight, when your linh lực falls below a quarter, the lock opens: you regain half your linh lực and gain a haze ward worth 10 % of your health.

sets.story: Everything the pirates left in the cove with a three-year-old girl: the lock, a fan under the salt and the cloth around it. Diêm has never learned whether the chest was meant for her.

sets.name: Poria Under Pine (Tùng Hạ Phục Linh)

bonuses.effect: Nobody Falls (Vô Nhân Đảo): once a fight, a heal that lands on you while you are below a quarter of your health also gives you a Wood ward worth 10 % of your health.

sets.story: Her mirror, her village's gourd and her master's robe: a support's set, made for the quiet sect she wants to keep.

sets.name: Cliff Hall Champion (Nhai Đường Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Lean Until It Breaks (Ỷ Chí Đoạn): each hit on a foe whose guard you cracked adds a Wood stack and 3 % pierce against it, and every tenth such hit breaks the foe's block for 3 s; the pierce falls by 3 % each second you do not hit that foe.

sets.story: The ridge's champion's set: the cypress banner, his father's jade block and the Cliff Hall coat Cù gave him. He wears it at the new seat to remind them where it came from.
